_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Packaging Test Report
summary: The Packaging Test Report describes each packaging test sample, test, and sequence, including interpretation of results, failures, and corrective actions taken, and is used to evaluate packaging test results.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Packaging Test Report provides a description of each packaging test sample, packaging test, test sequence, and interpretation of test results including failures and corrective actions taken.
3.2 The Packaging Test Report is used to evaluate the results of packaging tests.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
7.2 The Packaging Test Report is related to the following DIDs:
a. Packaging Plan DI-PACK-80455
b. Packaging Test Plan DI-PACK-80456
c. Packaging Cost Analysis DI-PACK-80458
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Test Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Test Report content shall be as follows:

children.title: Title Page.
children.content: The title page shall include the contractor's name and address; contract number; project number; security classification; item, equipment or purchase description identification; and document title.

children.title: Identification.
children.content: Identify each system, subsystem, equipment, assembly, item, and component which was tested.

children.title: Test Description.
children.content: Describe each test sample and test conducted. Include both raw and derived data. Identify test sequence.

children.title: Test Results.
children.content: Describe and interpret the test results including failures. For each failure, describe the corrective actions taken with regard to the test sample and contents.

children.title: Signatures, Titles, and Dates.
children.content: The Packaging Test Report and revisions shall contain the signature and title of the contractor's authorized inspector, the contractor's authorized representative, and the Government's authorized representative and shall include the dates on which the signatures were affixed.
